speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have multiple skin lesions; to begin our assessment, can you tell me how long you have had them and whether they are itchy, painful, or bleeding?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Varicella (Chickenpox). Given the daycare exposure and the brother's recent chickenpox, the presentation of new papules despite immunizations is consistent with breakthrough varicella; I will confirm this by checking for vesicular lesions and ordering a Varicella-Specific IgM test.
